description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hadirawalana Ihalagama, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420350
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
